commands.name: use
commands.summary: Prepare the repo if needed, load the current Pulse session, and route the next workflow move.
commands.hint: Use first in any new, resumed, or suspiciously stale Pulse session, or whenever runtime/session posture is unclear.

commands.name: explore
commands.summary: Investigate the repo and lock implementation-relevant decisions against the chosen direction.
commands.hint: Use after a direction is chosen when the implementation context still needs evidence and decision locking.

commands.name: brainstorm
commands.summary: Turn vague intent into candidate approaches and an approved design spec.
commands.hint: Use before explore when feature shape is still open.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Convert explored context into an implementation shape.
commands.hint: Use after context is locked and execution shape is the next decision.

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Prove feasibility and expose blockers before execution starts.
commands.hint: Use before coding when you need evidence that the proposed slice is safe to execute.

commands.name: swarm
commands.hint: Use only when work can be split cleanly and explicit coordination is worth the cost.

commands.name: execute
commands.summary: Implement a validated work item and produce evidence.
commands.hint: Use after Gate 3 approval when the next move is to change code or state intentionally.

commands.name: review
commands.summary: Evaluate completed changes before merge or ship approval.
commands.hint: Use after execution to separate implementation from quality judgment.

commands.name: compound
commands.summary: Capture reusable learning after the workflow cycle.
commands.hint: Use when the team should get better from the work that just completed.
